Primary contrast: legacy rewritten − mapping V6. Negative MAE differences favor rewritten.
Four primary source families; descriptive fixed-cohort results, no population confidence intervals. Benefit and regret use an overlap-safe retired-instruction-count proxy; no CPU speedup claim.
All six comparisons are shown. Panels B–C are the declared primary contrast; other model comparisons are secondary.
